answer: Hand every agent a lantern: a public, signed record of its dealings that anyone can inspect. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand identities overnight, but each one must then grow a history of real, checkable transactions, slow as juniper growth, before anyone trusts it — and fabricating years of consistent behavior across a thousand shells costs more than the attack could earn. A forged reputation reads like a sonnet written by committee: technically verse, obviously hollow.
